FN-2JVMWIK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 78
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 78 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Early Childhood Education (ADECE) to: (1) develop guidelines for screen time use for children
5 years old and younger, in consultation with the Department of Human Resources (DHR), and
the State Board of Education (SBOE); (2) make the guidelines publicly available to parents and
guardians; (3) develop training related to the appropriate use of screen time in early childhood
education programs; and (4) ensure compliance with the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, it would increase the administrative obligations of DHR and SBOE to adopt rules
to implement and administer the provisions of this bill, and the local boards of education to
adopt screen time policies.
